narration.full_text: Hello and welcome to our journey into the fascinating world of real numbers! In this video, we'll explore what real numbers are, why they're so fundamental to mathematics, and how they help us understand the world around us. By the end, you'll have a solid grasp of their definition and importance. Let's dive in!
